description: Geocoding: convert an address, place name, or free-text location query into geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude). Returns formatted address, country, lat, lon, type, and match score. Example: geocode({ query: "350 5th Ave, New York" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own TomTom API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5)

query.description: Address or place to geocode, e.g. "350 5th Ave, New York" or "Eiffel Tower"

name: geocode
